title.en: Choose the right measure when outliers are present

say.en: If someone asks how your class did in the test, you will not read out 60 marks. You will give one number that represents everyone. Which number should it be? In this lesson: Compute mean, median and mode.
Choose the right measure when outliers are present.
Use Python's statistics module.

body.en: The mean is the sum of the values divided by their number. The *median* is the middle value after sorting; for an even count it is the average of the two middle values. The mode is the value that occurs most often. The median is not much affected by extreme values (outliers), while the mean is.

narration.en: Mean is the sum divided by the count. Median is the middle of the sorted list. Mode is the value that appears most often.
narration.kn: ಸರಾಸರಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿದುದು. ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿದ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಮಧ್ಯದ ಮೌಲ್ಯ. ಬಹುಲಕ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬಾರಿ ಬರುವ ಮೌಲ್ಯ.

Mode equals most frequent value.

title.en: On the board: Mean, median and mode, and an outlier

say.en: Seven students’ scores: 12, 15, 11, 15, 18, 14, 15. Sort them first.
The mean is the sum divided by the count: 100 over 7, about 14.3. The median is the middle value, the fourth: 15.
The mode is the value that occurs most often: 15 appears three times.
Now add one extreme score, 60. The mean jumps to 20, but the median and mode stay at 15.
So with extreme values, the median describes typical data better than the mean.

text.en: Outliers pull the mean, not the median

problem.en: Find the mean, median and mode of marks 45, 72, 60, 72, 38, 85, 72, 50.

steps.en: Sorted: 38, 45, 50, 60, 72, 72, 72, 85. Middle two: 60 and 72, so median = 66.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Find the mean, median and mode of marks 45, 72, 60, 72, 38, 85, 72, 50.

say.en: Let us work through this together. Find the mean, median and mode of marks 45, 72, 60, 72, 38, 85, 72, 50.
Sum equals 494, n equals 8, so mean equals 494 divided by 8 equals 61.75.
Sorted: 38, 45, 50, 60, 72, 72, 72, 85. Middle two: 60 and 72, so median equals 66.
72 occurs three times, so mode equals 72.
So the answer is Mean 61.75, median 66, mode 72.

What does this Python program print?

marks = [45, 72, 60, 72, 38, 85, 72, 50]
print(sum(marks) / len(marks))
print(statistics.median(marks))
print(statistics.mode(marks))
